description: This file provides OAuth2 support in Go, including configuration, token management, and HTTP client creation for OAuth2 authenticated requests.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents OAuth2 client configuration including client ID, secret, endpoints, redirect URL, and scopes.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: Contains OAuth2 provider's authorization and token endpoint URLs, and optional authentication style.

classes.name: AuthStyle
classes.description: Enumeration of how OAuth2 token requests are authenticated (auto-detect, in params, in header).

classes.name: AuthCodeOption
classes.description: Interface for options passed to OAuth2 authorization URL, such as access type or prompt.

classes.name: setParam
classes.description: Implementation of AuthCodeOption for key-value URL parameters.

classes.name: TokenSource
classes.description: Interface for objects that can return OAuth2 tokens.

classes.name: tokenRefresher
classes.description: TokenSource that refreshes tokens using a refresh token.

classes.name: reuseTokenSource
classes.description: TokenSource that caches and reuses tokens, refreshing when expired.

classes.name: staticTokenSource
classes.description: TokenSource that always returns the same token.

methods.name: AuthCodeURL
methods.description: Generates the OAuth2 authorization URL with optional parameters.

methods.name: PasswordCredentialsToken
methods.description: Obtains a token using resource owner username and password.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for a token.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client that automatically authorizes requests with a token.

methods.name: TokenSource
methods.description: Returns a token source that supplies a specific token, refreshing as needed.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client from a context and token source.

methods.name: ReuseTokenSource
methods.description: Returns a token source that reuses a token until it expires.

methods.name: ReuseTokenSourceWithExpiry
methods.description: Returns a token source with configurable early expiry buffer.

methods.name: StaticTokenSource
methods.description: Returns a token source that always supplies the same token.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Represents an OAuth2 token (not detailed in this excerpt).
